english:
Killing an <arc/>Arc-Debuffed enemy grants 1 <arc Bolt Charge />.

Scoring 3 Arc-Debuffed kills within 6 seconds spawns an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy and restores 35 HP.

source.text:
On Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kill:
Grants x1 Bolt Charge.

Upon scoring 3 Arc-Debuffed Enemy Kills within 6 seconds of each:
Spawns an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Restores 35 HP.
